name: Pin Pals
blurb: Pull back, hold, flick. Three alleys, ten pins, one thumb.

background.css: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(30,23,18,.94) 0 30px, rgba(30,23,18,0) 70px), radial-gradient(ellipse at 78% 18%, rgba(212,162,76,.35), transparent 50%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,.10) 0 1px, transparent 1px 13px), linear-gradient(180deg, #3a2b20 0%, #8a6440 55%, #C4955F 100%)

source.notes: From the Claude Design draft card: Maple Alley's Bricolage Grotesque title on the dark alley #1E1712, maple lane boards #C4955F and the brass accent #D4A24C. Board stripes fade up from the lane into the dark room, with a brass glow top-right behind the pin.
